fonts.display: 'angellistDisplay', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'angellist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Inkwell Teal
palette.role: Primary text, heading fill, hero background, card backgrounds for high-contrast panels

palette.name: Vellum Lavender
palette.role: Signature accent — highlight washes behind text, section badges, decorative strokes, the right-hand terminus of display gradients

palette.name: Sage Mist
palette.role: Dominant canvas background, hairline borders, dividers

palette.name: Paper White
palette.role: Card surfaces, image panels, inverse text on dark

palette.name: Bone
palette.role: Warm off-white alt surface, muted body text on dark backgrounds

palette.name: Driftwood
palette.role: Subtle banded sections, tertiary surface layer

palette.name: Slate Veil
palette.role: Mid-gray supporting text, muted UI labels

palette.name: Pewter Deep
palette.role: Dark banded section fills, layered surface

palette.name: Gunmetal
palette.role: Even darker banded fills, image overlay scrim base

palette.name: Patina
palette.role: Deepest teal — link backgrounds, footer anchors

palette.name: Pebble
palette.role: Muted surface layer for stacked color bands
